name: Zefir
positioning: France's first collective-sale real estate platform, pairing a neighborhood network of agents with an AI assistant to sell homes faster.
description: Zefir is a French home-selling platform built around what it calls "Vente Collective": rather than assigning a listing to a single agent, Zefir routes it to every partner agent active in the seller's neighborhood, who work the same mandate together to reach more buyers through a shared dashboard. Zefir Search is a conversational AI assistant (branded ZIA) that lets buyers describe the property they want in natural language instead of setting portal filters, and Zefir Connect is the free channel through which partner agents receive matched buyers and new mandates.
real_estate_use: A homeowner requests a valuation on Zefir and the listing is opened to every partner agent covering that neighborhood, who compete and collaborate to bring buyers under a shared timeline, with the seller tracking offers and buyer feedback from a dashboard. A buyer runs a conversational search with ZIA instead of scrolling filtered portal results, describing what they want as they would to an agent, and receives listings ranked for relevance. A local agent joins Zefir Connect at no upfront cost to receive pre-qualified buyer leads and new mandates generated by the platform.
features: Vente Collective — shared listing exposure across a network of local partner agents
ZIA, a conversational AI assistant for buyer search
Zefir Connect, free lead and mandate routing for partner agents
Seller dashboard with real-time sale progress and buyer feedback

use_cases.job: Get an automated valuation and let a network of local agents jointly market the property to sell faster
Receive matched buyer leads and new mandates through Zefir Connect at no upfront cost
